blurb: Guests enjoy a 60-minute cruise on Lake Mont Tremblant with narration in French and English about local heritage, stories, and legends. Options include public cruises, private charters, dinner cruises, brunch cruises, and fishing excursions. The vessel is fully handicapped accessible and offers refreshment services on board.
extraNote: Cruise operates in rain; may cancel or delay in storm or strong winds · First come, first served boarding; no reservations for public cruises · $250 deposit required for group charters; refundable if cancelled 30+ days before event · Deposit non-refundable if cancellation less than 30 days before event · Boarding at the Parc des Chutes dock or Tremblant Activity Center in Tremblant Pedestrian Village · Mid-spring to mid-fall
